user.title: Add an ArktIQ Coach account
user.description: One entry per person. Create a read-only API key in the app under Settings → Personal API.

data_description.name: Who this key belongs to, e.g. Remi or Kari.
data_description.base_url: The address of your ArktIQ Coach instance.
data_description.api_key: The personal API key (akq_…), shown once when created.

reauth_confirm.title: Replace the API key
reauth_confirm.description: The API key for {name} was rejected — it was probably revoked. Create a new key in the app and paste it here.

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the ArktIQ Coach instance.
error.invalid_auth: The API key was rejected. Check that you pasted the full akq_… token and that it has not been revoked.

abort.already_configured: This API key is already configured.

data_description.scan_interval: How often to poll today's tasks and the summary. Badges and metrics refresh every 6th poll.
data_description.tracked_metrics: Which metrics to expose as sensors. Custom keys are allowed for future packs.
data_description.track_badges: Poll earned badges (needed for badge sensors and badge events).
